title: Instance record (inst_…)
description: Where an environment is provisioned and what everything in it is called (glossary: Instance; R13a, R13b; decision 29). A frozen record of every literal name and placement a provisioning run will use, written by the instance generator before the run for one generation of a lineage; the provisioning command derives no name and checks every derived name against the recipes' fixed rules. Used for exactly one run. Unsigned.

plate.description: The plate this instance was generated for; `servings[].id` are that plate's serving ids.

lineage.description: The environment's identity across generations, chosen by the organization: `acme/webshop/production`. Found in receipts; the generator reads the lineage's latest receipt for the last generation.

generation.description: One more than the lineage's latest receipt's generation. Every name below includes it.

suffix.description: Present for a DERIVED name: this entry is the name input at `path` plus `suffix`, as the recipe's `derive` rule states; the provisioning command checks the equality.

names.description: A literal name for every name input of the serving's dish, down through every component, AND every name derived from one by a recipe's `derive` rule (marked with its `suffix`). Every name the kitchen will send is here. The provisioning command refuses a missing name or one that does not equal its derivation.

servings.description: One entry per serving the plate provisions in this run. Carried servings have no entry: their names stand in the receipt they are carried from.
